programs.title: Destroyer
programs.desc: Second World War drama about a warship assigned to mail runs but that ends up engaged in battle anyway, starring Edward G Robinson, Glenn Ford and Marguerite Chapman.

programs.title: The Undefeated
programs.desc: Civil War-era western starring John Wayne and Rock Hudson. Union and Confederate soldiers reluctantly join forces to fight against Mexican Emperor Maximillian's invasion.

programs.title: Imitation of Life
programs.desc: Lana Turner and Oscar-nominated Juanita Moore star in Douglas Sirk's powerful melodrama, which explores race relations and mother-daughter relationships.

programs.title: Le Mans '66
programs.desc: Oscar-winning sports drama starring Matt Damon and Christian Bale. In the 60s, Ford set out to build a car that can defeat Ferrari at the 24 Hours of Le Mans race.

programs.title: Midnight Run
programs.desc: Action comedy. Robert De Niro stars as a bounty hunter transporting a criminal from New York to Los Angeles with the FBI and the mob hot on their tail. With Charles Grodin.
